short: A thousand days containing the closest the Cold War came to nuclear war.
full:
Kennedy was 43 at his inauguration, the youngest man elected to the office and the first Catholic to hold it. His opening months brought the failed Bay of Pigs landing in April 1961, a bruising summit with Khrushchev in Vienna, and the building of the Berlin Wall.

In October 1962 American reconnaissance found Soviet medium-range missiles in Cuba. Kennedy chose a naval quarantine over the air strikes his chiefs urged, and after thirteen days the missiles were withdrawn in exchange for a public pledge not to invade and a private undertaking to remove American missiles from Turkey. The Limited Test Ban Treaty followed in 1963, as did his commitment to land a man on the moon before the decade was out. He was shot in Dallas on 22 November 1963 and pronounced dead within the hour.
